source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Azrael can issue a **[combat doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines)** in your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase). He picks one friendly **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** unit he can see no farther away than 9″. The doctrine expires as your next Command phase begins.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
